title: eCH-0270 - Génération de codes-barres
why_needed: Defines the 1D and 2D barcodes printed on tax documents that Taxpresso has to read
notes: v1.0.0 approved (decision 2024-11-27), French translation of German original, no annexes; payload compression given only as ZIP, deflate variant not specified

title: E-Tax NP
why_needed: Successor data format to eCH-0119 for natural person tax data; target structure for future structured tax submissions
notes: v1.0.0 first version; cover says approved and issued 2026-02-05, but body gives approval decision 2026-05-18 and says not yet normatively valid, so status needs confirming; XSD and Excel annex URLs not found

title: Annex de eCH-0196 Relevé fiscal électronique V2.2.0 - Génération de codes-barres - instructions techniques

why_needed: Barcode and XML payload spec for e-Steuerauszug (eCH-0196) documents: Code128C 1D, PDF417 Structured Append 2D, ZLIB-compressed payload
notes: Annex to eCH-0196 V2.2.0 (decision 2022-06-02, approved); file name says V2.0.0; annex example uses country code SO, probably meant CH; eCH-0196 V2.x main document and XSD not found

title: E-Tax Filing

notes: v4.0.0 approved (decision 2021-03-02), replaces v3.2; no v4.1 or later found in search; XSD eCH-0119-4-0-0.xsd URL not found

title: Généralités

title: Certificat de salaire et attestation de rentes

title: Directives certificat de salaire (20200220_20201026)
publisher: Swissdec (Suva, AVS/AI, Conférence suisse des impôts with the AFC, OFS, ASA)
why_needed: Specification of the salary certificate's 2D barcode (form 11): the TxAB XML schema, its packing in an Info-ZIP archive with one entry named txab, and the 14 control bytes at the start of each PDF417 symbol
notes: ZIP archive (ELM 5.0, listed on https://www.swissdec.ch/elm): pdf/TaxAccountingOverview_f.pdf (45 pages; p. 35 ZIP and entry name, p. 36-37 control bytes), schema/SalaryDeclarationTxAB.xsd with 20200220Common_Tax_noNS.xsd and 20200220SalaryDeclaration_Tax_noNS.xsd (each element documents its box: c1 to c15, E, F, G), xsl/TaxAccountingBcdTrans.xsl, test data. Namespace http://www.swissdec.ch/schema/sd/20200220/SalaryDeclarationTxAB

title: Annexe 5 Directives certificat de salaire (20260306)
publisher: Swissdec (Suva, AVS/AI, Conférence suisse des impôts with the AFC, OFS, ASA)
why_needed: ELM 6.0 edition of the salary certificate barcode specification: same control bytes and ZIP packing, new TxAB namespace and schema
notes: ZIP archive with the guide in German, French and Italian: pdf/Richtlinien_Barcode_fr.pdf (p. 10 section 2.1 ZIP and entry txab, p. 10-11 section 2.2 control bytes, p. 11-12 symbol: EC level 2, aspect ratio 1.2), schema/SalaryDeclarationTxAB.xsd (namespace urn:ch:swissdec:elm:v6:20260306:SalaryDeclarationTxAB) and ELMv6SalaryDeclaration_Tax_noNS.xsd (S and A add CreationDate and @addresseeIDRef)

title: eCH-0196 E-Steuerauszug V2.2.0, XML schema eCH-0196-2-2.xsd
publisher: Verein eCH (authors: Conférence suisse des impôts)
why_needed: Schema of the bank e-tax statement XML carried by its barcode: accounts, liabilities, expenses and securities with tax values, gross income A/B and withholding tax
notes: Namespace http://www.ech.ch/xmlns/eCH-0196/2 (minorVersion attribute); imports eCH-0007/6, eCH-0008/3, eCH-0010/7 and eCH-0097/4 from www.ech.ch/xmlns (not in the library); bank extensions allowed in other namespaces (xs:any and xs:anyAttribute ##other); listed on https://www.ech.ch/de/ech/ech-0196/2.2.0

title: eCH-0196 Relevé fiscal électronique V2.2.0

title: Beilage zu eCH-0196 E-Steuerauszug V2.2.0, Technische Wegleitung
publisher: Verein eCH (authors: Conférence suisse des impôts)
why_needed: Technical guide of the e-tax statement: how the barcode segments are made and read back
notes: Section 3 (p. 35-37): the API generates the segment images at 1 x 1 pixel per barcode element, extracts the XML from the last page backwards and renders a page when it has no barcode images; the API itself is no longer published
